title: 第140章 他要是个女的该多好第139章 陈玄的交代
content_zh:
第一卷第140章他要是个女的该多好……
暮色降临。
李沧海几人结伴去了趟葫芦庙。
陈昶此行主要是和负责镇上庙宇的二副教主混个脸熟。
宋金纪最近的生活可以说是平静、枯燥、且无趣。
自飞仙门大劫过去，凌仙阁被连根拔起，教主又不知所踪，临走时只是说了些大体上的规划，并未交代新的任务，导致葫芦教堂堂副教主，整日做着与庙祝一样的活。
灵晶拿在手里都觉得烫手。
不过兄弟几人更是打定主意要跟着陈玄干。
几月前飞仙门一位高人专程跑来，说什么葫芦仙人是掌门非常敬重的一位前辈，为表达飞仙门的敬意，要帮忙在灵宝镇盖一座大庙。
倒是让兄弟几人有些措手不及。
难不成真的有葫芦仙人？
要不是哥几个全程见证了葫芦教的兴起，还真就相信了。
但也侧面说明教主背景深不可测，连飞仙门的掌门都要讨好他！
紫凝上人何许人也？
仓衍洲是数一数二的高人，居然派人过来主动示好！
换做以前，别说紫凝上人，就是飞仙门派过来的那个执事，他们远远看上一眼都觉得三生有幸，能吹嘘许久。
现在嘛……
也就那样。
正当宋金纪躺在软榻上，享受枯燥的副教主生活时，这座葫芦庙的庙祝走进房间。
“二副教主，大殿来了几个人，说是飞仙门的修士。”

宋金纪坐直身子跳下软榻，走到一旁的桌案前，对庙祝说道：“快请他们进来！”
“是！”
庙祝躬身退去。
宋金纪心情舒畅。
今时不同往日，以前有飞仙门仙人到访，他恨不得跑出去跪地磕头。
现在却只需往这一坐，招呼手下人请人就是。
他这个葫芦教的副教主，地位与飞仙门的长老也差不太多了吧？
宋金纪嘴角抑制不住的上扬。
不多时，庙祝带着四人进了屋子。
宋金纪赶忙起身相迎，“诸位仙长莅临寒舍，当真令小庙蓬荜生辉呀！”
咱现在也是葫芦教的三把手，代表着葫芦教的形象，说话什么的，自然要学得文雅一些。
几人中生得最俊俏的青年朝宋金纪作揖笑道：“副教主言重了，我等只是飞仙门普通弟子，受一位同门所托，带些东西过来。”
宋金纪含笑点头，指了指对面的椅子，“请坐。”
说完，率先落座，端起茶壶开始煮茶。
李沧海等人落座后，便直接说明了来意，将陈昶介绍给了宋金纪。
当宋金纪得知往后他们几人的工资、丹药由陈昶带来时，也是立马明白陈昶与教主关系非同一般，重新审视起面前的这帮人，神态动作也更加尊敬了几分。
李沧海等人并未在葫芦庙久留，简单聊了半个时辰，将一封信交给宋金纪，便告辞离去。
送走几人后，宋金纪才回到屋子，有些疑惑地拆开信封。
李沧海说信是一位叫陈天寿的同门带来的，但他又不认识什么陈天寿。
content_en:
Volume 1 Chapter 140 It would be great if he were a woman...
Dusk falls.
Li Canghai and others went to the Calabash Temple together.
Chen Chang's trip was mainly to get acquainted with the second deputy leader in charge of the temple in the town.
The recent life of Song and Jinji can be said to be calm, boring, and boring.
Since the catastrophe of Feixianmen, Lingxian Pavilion has been uprooted, and the leader has disappeared. Before leaving, he only talked about some general plans and did not give new tasks. As a result, the deputy leader of Gourd Church has been doing the same work as temple blessing all day long.
The spiritual crystal felt hot to the touch even in my hand.
However, the brothers were even more determined to follow Chen Xuan.
A few months ago, an expert from the Feixian Sect made a special trip and said that Gourd Immortal was a senior that the master respected very much. To express the Feixian Sect's respect, he wanted to help build a large temple in Lingbao Town.
It caught the brothers a little off guard.
Is it possible that there really is a Gourd Immortal?
If I hadn't witnessed the rise of Calabash Sect, I would have believed it.
But it also shows that the leader’s background is unfathomable, and even the head of the Feixian Sect wants to please him!
Who is Master Zi Ning?
Cang Yanzhou is one of the top experts, and he actually sent someone over to show his kindness!
In the past, let alone Master Zi Ning, he was the deacon sent by the Feixian Sect. They all thought they were lucky enough to be able to brag about him for a long time.
Now...
That's it.
While Song Jinji was lying on the soft couch, enjoying the boring life of a deputy leader, the priest of the Calabash Temple walked into the room.
"Second Deputy Cult Master, several people came to the main hall, saying they are monks from Feixian Sect."
Song Jinji sat up straight and jumped off the soft couch, walked to the table beside him, and said to Miao Zhu: "Invite them in quickly!"
"Yes!"
Temple Zhu bowed and retreated.
Song Jinji was in a good mood.
Today is different from the past. In the past, when an immortal from the Feixian Sect came to visit, he could not wait to run out and kneel down to kowtow.
Now all I have to do is sit here and greet my subordinates.
As the deputy leader of Calabash Sect, his status is not much different from that of the elders of Feixian Sect, right?
The corners of Song Jinji's mouth couldn't help but rise.
Not long after, Miao Zhu led four people into the house.
Song Jinji hurriedly stood up to greet him, "The presence of all the immortals in this humble residence will really make the small temple shine!"
We are also the third-in-command of the Calabash Sect now, representing the image of the Calabash Sect. We naturally have to learn to be more polite when speaking.
The most handsome young man among them bowed to Song Jin Jizuo and said with a smile: "The deputy leader is serious. We are just ordinary disciples of Feixian Sect. We were entrusted by a fellow disciple to bring some things here."
Song Jinji nodded with a smile and pointed to the chair opposite, "Please sit down."
After saying that, he took the seat first, picked up the teapot and started making tea.
After Li Canghai and others took their seats, they directly explained their intention and introduced Chen Chang to Song Jinji.
When Song Jinji learned that Chen Chang would bring their salaries and elixirs, he immediately understood that the relationship between Chen Chang and the leader was extraordinary. He re-examined the group of people in front of him, and his demeanor and actions became more respectful.
Li Canghai and others did not stay in the Calabash Temple for long. They chatted briefly for half an hour, handed a letter to Song Jinji, and then left.
After seeing off a few people, Song Jinji returned to the house and opened the envelope with some confusion.
Li Canghai said that the letter was brought by a fellow student named Chen Tianshou, but he did not know Chen Tianshou.
